en.headline: Pui takes Asian Games silver in men's ILCA 7 sailing
en.dek: Pui Chun-lung finished second in the men's ILCA 7, two points behind the Korean winner, RTHK reported.
body: Hong Kong sailor Pui Chun-lung won silver in the men's single-handed ILCA 7 at the Asian Games in Nagoya, RTHK reported on Friday.
Pui finished the medal race with 11 points, two points behind the South Korean sailor who took gold. Malaysia took the bronze, according to RTHK.
RTHK said the Hong Kong sailing team had collected two silvers and one bronze at these Games after Pui's result.
The medal is separate from the sailing medals reported on Thursday, when other Hong Kong crews also reached the podium in Nagoya.

zh.headline: 貝俊龍亞運男子ILCA 7帆船摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊貝俊龍在名古屋亞運男子單人艇ILCA 7以11分位列第二，落後韓國選手兩分奪銀。
body: 香港電台報道，港隊帆船手貝俊龍星期五在名古屋亞運男子單人艇ILCA 7級賽事奪得銀牌。
港台指，貝俊龍決賽總分11分，排第二，與韓國冠軍只差兩分。銅牌由馬來西亞選手奪得。
港台稱，計入這面銀牌後，港隊帆船在今屆亞運已累積兩銀一銅。
這面獎牌有別於星期四已報道的帆船獎牌，當時其他港隊組合亦在名古屋登上頒獎台。
